Privacy and network

Identity and delivery

Your Mayday ID links your profile to your account keys. The app picks a delivery route based on the network available.

Chat using your name or a nickname

Share your Mayday ID or QR code to start a chat. Your phone number is kept out of your public profile. You can choose whether people can find you by number.

Sign-up requires SMS verification.

Decentralized delivery

Devices on the same local network can connect directly. Over the internet, Mayday can use relay nodes, including nodes you add in network settings.

You
DirectVia relay
Contact

Private messages are encrypted on the sender’s device. When a direct route is unavailable, a relay can forward the encrypted data.

Conversation rewards

From message to wallet

Eligible outgoing messages earn 1 LBU₽ with proof of delivery. Claim your rewards in Conversation Rewards. Once confirmed by the network, they appear in your Mayday wallet.

Rewards have already been credited in a pilot run. LBU₽ is a token on the Mayday network.

How rewards work

1LBU₽ per eligible message
  • up to 50 LBU₽ per day
  • up to 15 LBU₽ per contact per day

Bot builder

Make a bot without code

Open Services → Bots → My bots. Add a welcome message, commands, pictures, and buttons. You can set up a bot with ready-made replies without writing code.

Connect a website to your bot to receive leads in chat. Use the API for custom workflows.

Chats and services

Inside Mayday

Groups and channels

Create a group for friends or keep one just for yourself. Pin important messages and publish photos, videos, and files in channels.

Audio and video calls

Call friends one to one. Groups can start audio calls with up to eight people.

Stories and media

Post photos and videos for 24 hours, edit images, and save received photos to your gallery.

Mini apps

Open web services from a bot chat. Mayday asks for permission before sharing data covered by the app’s permissions.

Wallet

Send and receive LBU₽ by address or contact. Confirm transactions in your Mayday wallet.

Games in chat

Play long backgammon and chess from the Games chat.

Replies and reactions

Swipe a message to reply with a quote, or pick a reaction from the message menu.

Profile photo album

Choose a photo from your gallery or take one with the camera. Previous photos stay in your album.

Sign in with Mayday ID

Confirm sign-in to connected services such as Bankomet directly in Mayday.
